name: Sentry Error Tracking
description: Real-time error monitoring and performance tracing with Sentry — captures exceptions, stack traces, and user context.

requiredSecrets.name: SENTRY_DSN
requiredSecrets.reason: Sentry Data Source Name (DSN) for your project

requiredSecrets.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
requiredSecrets.reason: Sentry auth token for source map uploads during build

postInstallNotes:
1. Call `initSentry()` at the very top of your server entry point before any other imports.
2. Add `Sentry.expressErrorHandler()` as the last middleware in your Express app to capture unhandled errors.
3. Set `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` in your CI environment to upload source maps and get readable stack traces.
